plainText:
Eva Christensen is an American voice actress for the English-language dub of .

==Biography==
Christensen first began to provide voices in Pokémon during the seventh season. As with most other voice actors who worked with 4Kids Entertainment, she left when and TAJ Productions took over the dubbing and distribution of the series. Later, she provided the voice of in Try for the Family Stone!, making her the second-to-last former 4Kids voice actor to return to the in . Christensen is currently affiliated with Stewart Talent Agency.
